objective.statement: Make the Codex external harness a client-specific overlay of the released Purpose Tool skill.
objective.measure: The duplicate Home Manager skill mapping and source are absent; five explicit profiles and the launcher remain tested; verifier effort is none.

need.statement: The dotfiles-owned skill duplicates the new canonical Purpose Tool skill and its forced Home Manager mapping can prevent a released skill projection from remaining in sync.
need.baseline: home/modules/files.nix force-maps config/codex/skills/external-harness-orchestration into ~/.codex/skills; the existing contract test requires this duplicate.
need.consequence_of_no_action: Codex can load stale policy from the client copy after Purpose Tool releases a different canonical skill.
alternatives_considered: Keep two full skills synchronized manually
Remove the Codex profiles and launcher along with the duplicate skill

purpose: Reconcile the Codex client overlay with the canonical Purpose Tool external harness skill.
consumer: Codex root coordinators on this devbox and the Purpose Tool host-skill installer.
contract: Remove the dotfiles-owned duplicate skill and forced Home Manager mapping; keep the five explicit external Codex profiles, launcher, and minimal root-orchestrator trigger. The external-verifier profile must set model_reasoning_effort to none. The released Purpose Tool skill owns generic policy.
failure_boundary: Do not edit the live ~/.codex/skills projection by hand, change the managed AGENTS block, weaken the launcher or profile tests, activate Home Manager before the released Engine skill is confirmed, or delegate land/push.

evidence.description: node --test scripts/test-codex-external-harness-skill.mjs scripts/test-codex-hosted-search.mjs scripts/test-codex-external-run.mjs rejects duplicate ownership and proves role profiles and launcher.

falsifier.claim: Codex remains a working external harness client without owning a fork of the Purpose Tool skill.

executable_check.description: Run focused contract tests and repository check; a duplicate mapping, missing explicit profile, or verifier effort other than none falsifies the claim.

invariants: Codex root orchestrates and remains sole publication authority
Profiles and launcher remain Home Manager-managed
Purpose Tool alone owns the reusable skill source

assumptions.statement: Engine will release the canonical external-harness-orchestration skill before host sync.
assumptions.falsifier: Engine land fails or Forgejo main lacks the canonical skill.

assumptions.statement: The dotfiles worktree is isolated and owned for this objective.
assumptions.falsifier: repo vcs worktree-list no longer lists the named branch/path.

plane_constraints: Purpose Tool in Engine owns the canonical base skill; dotfiles owns only Codex client-specific profiles, launcher, and trigger.
